query:
select c.pkscript, c.balance::text as "balance!"
            from runes_current_balances c
            where c.rune_id = $1
              and ($2::text is null or (c.balance, c.pkscript) < ($2::text::numeric, $3::bytea))
            order by c.balance desc, c.pkscript desc
            limit $4;
